name: command-bar
title: CommandBar
description: Ctrl/⌘K command bar: ARIA combobox and listbox in a native modal dialog, results grouped by kind.

a11y.pattern: WAI-ARIA 1.2 combobox with listbox popup (aria-activedescendant), in a native <dialog> opened with showModal()
keyboard: Opens the bar (globalShortcut), or closes it when open
Runs the active item (mkCommand) and closes the bar
Closes the bar and returns focus to the element that opened it
Stays inside the dialog (focus trap): search field, then Close
aria: input role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant, aria-autocomplete=list
Listbox: div role=listbox > div role=group aria-label (Actions, Services, Operations, Tests) > div role=option aria-selected; the group titles are visual only (aria-hidden)
A polite live region announces "5 results" or "No results"
The dialog has an accessible name (label) and the search field has a real <label>
Focus is restored to the opener, including through shadow roots
a11y.notes: In modal mode, drive it with the open property and update your state in onClose. Home/End navigate the options rather than moving the text cursor. Use inline for docs and embedding. Angular: add schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA].
